flavor: A bloated, grey-skinned 僵尸 sits slumped against a stone pillar, its skull encased in a heavy, rusted iron helmet. The metal is dented inward as if struck by a massive force, yet the creature's jaw remains clamped shut around a glowing, pulsating jade bead.
name: The Iron-Crowned Corpse
reason: The party discovers a relic of a fallen martial master, preserved in a state of undeath.
